function.description: Run bash in the task workdir in a fresh shell. Workspace files persist, but shell variables and cd do not persist between calls. Do not assume root privileges or installed tools; check only what the task needs. In confined sessions only the project and allowed scratch are writable; sandbox denial is a policy denial, not a reason to bypass confinement. Returns exit_code and stdout/stderr tails. Use jobs for background commands, services, and long builds; do not manage them with nohup or shell polling. Before deletion or moving files, verify the intended path and guard unset path variables.
function.name: term.exec

command.description: a bash command line, run from the task workdir

function.description: Find code by literal substring under the task workdir; returns path:line hits (max 100).
function.name: repo.search

function.description: Read a file window under the task workdir. The reply tells you total_lines and a truncated flag; if truncated, page forward with start_line=end_line+1. NEVER re-read the same window: recent results stay verbatim in your transcript. Put durable facts in notes.scratch.
function.name: repo.read

function.description: Ask the user one question and wait for the answer. Use only when a decision is genuinely theirs and you cannot proceed safely on a stated assumption. Optional options lists suggested answers. If no answer arrives you get an error: continue on your best assumption and say so.
function.name: ask_user_question

function.description: Background jobs in the same confined shell as term.exec. op=start {command} returns at once with an id; op=list shows status and exit codes; op=output {id, tail_bytes?} reads the log while it runs; op=kill {id} ends it. Use for servers, watchers and long builds instead of blocking a step.
function.name: jobs

function.description: Find files by glob pattern (e.g. **/*.rs), relative to the workspace or an optional subpath. Honors .gitignore; sorted; limit default 200.
function.name: glob

function.description: Your task list for multi-step work (todo_write). Pass todos=[{content, status: pending|in_progress|completed}] to replace the list (at most one in_progress); call with no todos to read it back.
function.name: todo

function.description: Show a finished file from the workspace to the user (report, image, document). path is relative to the workspace; optional title.
function.name: present

function.description: Read a PNG, JPEG or GIF from the workspace: returns mime, width, height and base64 data (max 5 MB).
function.name: read_image

function.description: Recurring prompts. op=create {prompt, every_secs>=60}, list, update {id, prompt?, every_secs?}, delete {id}, due (entries now due; advances them).
function.name: schedule

function.description: Voice: speak text aloud into a WAV file in the workspace with the configured text-to-speech voice. {text, path?} (relative .wav path, default .hs/voice/<time>.wav). Fails with a clear error when no voice is configured.
function.name: speak

function.description: Named multi-step workflows. op=define {name, steps: [prompt,...]}, get {name}, list, delete {name}. The harness runs a workflow's steps as goals back to back.
function.name: workflow

function.description: Track the long-running goal of this session. op=create {objective, acceptance?} (one active goal at a time), op=get, op=update {status: active|done|blocked, note?}. This is your own tracker; the mission still closes only through the checker.
function.name: goal

function.description: Plan mode. op=enter: mutating tools (term.exec, edits, jobs start, agent.spawn, answer.submit) are blocked while you research. op=exit {plan}: save your plan and leave plan mode so work can start. op=status reads the saved plan.
function.name: plan

function.description: Search the web (Brave Search API; needs HS_BRAVE_API_KEY). Returns title, url, snippet per result. Follow up with web.fetch to read a page.
function.name: web.search

function.description: Fetch an http(s) URL as text (HTML is reduced to readable text). Private, loopback and non-http targets are refused. Use for docs and API references; returns status, content_type, text, truncated.
function.name: web.fetch

function.description: Persistent notes that survive context truncation. Record hypotheses, commands that worked, and values you will need later; read them back instead of re-discovering.
function.name: notes.scratch

function.description: Finish the task: summary IS the final answer and overwrites ANSWER_PATH, including any file content you wrote there earlier. Match the requested answer format exactly (for example, one sentence or a number); do not turn a short answer into a work report. Do not append verification commentary unless the user requested it. For a code-change task, describe the change and verification. This triggers the checker, which runs YOUR .hs/checks against the live machine. Green ends the mission; red comes back as FEEDBACK. Your checks must be declared when you submit: write .hs/checks yourself in an earlier step, or pass them atomically in the optional checks field (one command per line, persisted to .hs/checks BEFORE the checker runs). Submit only when every check you declared passes.
function.name: answer.submit

checks.description: optional: your verification commands, one per line; persisted to .hs/checks BEFORE the checker runs on this submission

summary.description: the final answer content, written verbatim to ANSWER_PATH; obey the requested format

function.description: Delegate a self-contained subtask to a child sub-agent that runs the same harness on its own stream CONCURRENTLY: the call returns as soon as the child is running (status running, its stream id), and the harness tells you when it finishes (a delegation update names passed, steps, cost). Delegate every separable subtask as soon as you know it, then keep working; never poll for completion yourself. Optionally name a different registered model for the child. The parent linkage and stream id are injected by the harness - never pass parent_stream or child_stream_id yourself.
function.name: agent.spawn

model.description: optional: a registered model name for the child (default: the parent's default)

function.description: Like agent.spawn, but the child starts with your working context (files you read, edits, checks so far) so it continues from where you are instead of from scratch. Use for a branch of the same work.
function.name: agent.fork

function.description: List the sub-agents you delegated: child id, mission, state (running|done|lost), passed, steps.
function.name: agent.list

function.description: Send a message to a running sub-agent by child id; it sees it at its next step as operator steering.
function.name: agent.send

function.description: Ask a running sub-agent to stop at its next step boundary (booked as interrupted, not a failure of the harness).
function.name: agent.interrupt

function.description: List the installed world skills (name and one-line description). Skills are reusable, verified procedures; the prompt shows the same index.
function.name: skill.list

function.description: Load the full instructions of an installed skill by exact name (from the Installed skills index). Call it when a skill's description matches your task, before re-deriving the procedure.
function.name: skill.view
